rows: mgwr_summary.csv 311; istanbul_airbnb_h3.geojson 1,262 features (properties flattened to istanbul_airbnb_h3_properties.csv, 1,262 rows); mgwr_bandwidths.txt n/a; Spatial_Final_Version.py n/a
columns: mgwr_summary: h3_cell, listing_count, unlicensed_rate, mean_price(TRY), coef_bw30/60/101, sig_bw30/60/101. geojson props: h3_id, listing_count, unlicensed_count, unlicensed_pct, avg_price, median_price, avg_availability_365, entire_home_pct, active_post_reg_pct, avg_review_score, lisa_I, lisa_quad, lisa_p, lisa_cluster, booking_first, booking_last, booking_change
date_range: No date column. Single cross-section: Inside Airbnb Istanbul dump pulled 29-30 Sep 2025; calendar horizon Sep 2025-Sep 2026 (booking_first/last = first vs last month of that window); regime shock 1 Jan 2024 (Law No. 7464); repo last push 2026-06-13
how_pulled: for f in README.md Data/mgwr_summary.csv Data/mgwr_bandwidths.txt Data/istanbul_airbnb_h3.geojson Spatial_Final_Version.py; do curl -sL -o $(basename $f) https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eda-yilmaz/DI722_Istanbul_Airbnb/main/$f; done; gh api repos/eda-yilmaz/DI722_Istanbul_Airbnb/contents/Data; python (pandas/json) to flatten geojson properties to CSV and describe
full_dataset_size: Whole repo 8.9 MB (14 files under Data/: the 5 pulled + 6 HTML maps 0.3-4.3 MB each + 4 PNG); 1,262 H3 cells / 311 GWR cells; the underlying Inside Airbnb Istanbul listings.csv (30,051 x 79) and calendar.csv.gz (~10.9M rows) are NOT committed and are no longer on the Inside Airbnb CDN for that vintage
description: H3 resolution-8 hex-cell aggregates (1,262 cells) of one Inside Airbnb Istanbul cross-section (Sep 2025) classifying every listing as licensed/unlicensed/exempt under Turkey's national STR permit law (No. 7464, effective 1 Jan 2024), with cell-level unlicensed share, TRY price, availability, entire-home share, post-regulation activity share, Local Moran's I cluster labels, and a first-vs-last-month booking change from the 12-month forward calendar; a 311-cell GWR table adds the licensed-vs-unlicensed price coefficient at three bandwidths. Grain is H3 cell, single point in time, built by a METU graduate project from Inside Airbnb. For ABNB an analyst would use it as an EMEA compliance-decay datapoint (40.5% unlicensed, 27.7% among reviewed listings, 21 months after a national licensing shock) for the regulatory supply-risk factor, and reuse the licence-field classification rule and H3 pipeline on our own 120-market Jun-2026 cohort licence columns.
issues: No LICENSE file in the repo (author's derived work; upstream Inside Airbnb is CC BY 4.0) - human decision before quoting or redistributing. Single cross-section only, no pre-law baseline (author says 2023-24 Istanbul history was requested from Inside Airbnb, not received). Raw listings/calendar not committed. Ghost-listing caveat: 36% of listings have zero reviews and inflate the unlicensed rate. Prices in TRY under high inflation, not comparable across time without deflating. No dates inside the tables. tos_or_license_flag=true in the job card.
geography: Istanbul, Turkey (metropolitan area, 1,262 H3 res-8 cells; district figures in README_upstream.md)
